title: Magus Revert
summary: Magus Revert is an Arcane Enhancement for the Operator that restores Health on Void Sling for no energy cost while reverting the player's position back to where they started the Void Sling.
extract:
Magus Revert is an Arcane Enhancement for the Operator that restores Health on Void Sling for no energy cost while reverting the player's position back to where they started the Void Sling.

Effect

Acquisition
Can be bought from Vox Solaris (Syndicate) for  10,000 per blueprint upon reaching the rank of Shadow.

Notes
Has a 3-second cooldown.
Can be used with  Magus Lockdown to drop tether mines without consuming energy from Void Sling.
